# go/types can only read export data written by the Go release it was built
# with. When loopvec-toolexec was built with a different release than the
# toolchain running the build, packages are compiled unchanged, and the log
# (with LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_DEBUG) says why.

chmod 0755 compile
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_DEBUG=1
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG=$WORK/log
exec $LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC $WORK/compile -p example.com/x -importcfg $WORK/b001/importcfg x.go
cmpenv stdout stdout.want
! stderr .
stdout -count=1 '^fake compile: '
grep -count=1 '^skipped example\.com/x: loopvec-toolexec was built with go1\.[0-9]+ but the toolchain is go1\.1$' log

-- compile --
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = "-V=full" ]; then
	echo "compile version go1.1 X:simd"
	exit 0
fi
echo "fake compile: $@"
-- x.go --
package x
-- stdout.want --
fake compile: -p example.com/x -importcfg $WORK/b001/importcfg x.go
